node: Healthcare and nursing licensure education capacity: ABSN, OTA, simulation technology, VR training, prerequisites, and clinical-placement support
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a compact US-listed universe around healthcare licensure capacity. The clearest direct reference exposure is Adtalem through Chamberlain nursing and healthcare education scale. The underfollowed lane is more interesting: Grand Canyon Education appears tied to ABSN/OTA partner-program operations, off-campus classroom/lab economics, simulation technology and VR investments; HealthStream is a smaller healthcare workforce software vendor with clinical-development, credentialing, rotation, student-readiness and nursing-school adjacency; Strategic Education has a second-order prerequisite and healthcare-enrollment angle through Sophia Learning, Workforce Edge, Capella and Strayer, but its licensure-capacity linkage needs more verification. The chokepoint to test in later layers is whether growth is constrained by physical simulation labs, clinical placements, faculty/accreditation and state licensure pathways rather than by online content alone.
